description: FDA drug recall enforcement reports from openFDA, newest report first, filtered by optional drug, brand or firm text (every word must match; brand names also match their RxNorm ingredients), look-back months and FDA classification (I, II, III). Entries include recall number, classification, status, product description, reason, recalling firm, distribution pattern, initiation and report dates (ISO) and voluntary or mandated status, plus counts by classification. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

months.description: Look-back window on report date, 1 to 120 months (default 24 with q, 3 without).

q.description: Drug name, brand or recalling firm text. Omit for all recent drug recalls.

name: rx_recalls
title: FDA drug recalls (enforcement reports)
